text: Artificial intelligence is becoming part of our daily lives, so ethics in AI matters more than ever. One major problem is bias: if the data used to train AI is unfair, the results can be unfair too. This can harm certain groups of people. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI often collects personal information. People need to know how their data is used. Transparency helps here: companies should explain how their systems work. Finally, responsible AI development means thinking about the possible risks before releasing new technology. In short, we need AI that is fair, safe, and honest for everyone.
